<script>
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  /* Nav: scrolled state, progress bar, active link */
  const nav = document.getElementById("nav");
  const progress = document.getElementById("progress");
  const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll(".nav-links a");
  const sections = [...document.querySelectorAll("section[id]")];

  function onScroll() {
    const y = window.scrollY;
    nav.classList.toggle("scrolled", y > 40);
    const max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
    progress.style.width = (max > 0 ? y / max * 100 : 0) + "%";

    let current = "";
    sections.forEach(s => { if (y >= s.offsetTop - 200) current = s.id; });
    navLinks.forEach(a => a.classList.toggle("active", a.getAttribute("href") === "#" + current));
  }
  window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
  onScroll();

  /* Mobile menu */
  const menuBtn = document.getElementById("menuBtn");
  const linksEl = document.getElementById("navLinks");
  menuBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const open = linksEl.classList.toggle("open");
    menuBtn.classList.toggle("open", open);
    menuBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open);
  });
  navLinks.forEach(a => a.addEventListener("click", () => {
    linksEl.classList.remove("open");
    menuBtn.classList.remove("open");
  }));

  /* Scroll reveal */
  const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    entries.forEach(e => {
      if (e.isIntersecting) {
        e.target.classList.add("in");
        io.unobserve(e.target);
        const counter = e.target.querySelector("[data-count]");
        if (counter) animateCount(counter);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.15 });
  document.querySelectorAll(".reveal, .stat").forEach(el => io.observe(el));

  /* Count-up */
  function animateCount(el) {
    const target = parseFloat(el.dataset.count);
    const decimals = parseInt(el.dataset.decimals || "0", 10);
    if (reduceMotion) { el.textContent = target.toFixed(decimals); return; }
    const start = performance.now(), dur = 1400;
    function tick(now) {
      const p = Math.min((now - start) / dur, 1);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
      el.textContent = (target * eased).toFixed(decimals);
      if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  /* Hero portrait tilt + ambient cursor glow */
  const portrait = document.getElementById("portrait");
  const ambient = document.getElementById("ambient");
  if (!reduceMotion && window.matchMedia("(pointer: fine)").matches) {
    window.addEventListener("mousemove", e => {
      ambient.style.setProperty("--mx", e.clientX + "px");
      ambient.style.setProperty("--my", e.clientY + "px");
      const rect = portrait.getBoundingClientRect();
      const px = (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width - 0.5;
      const py = (e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height - 0.5;
      portrait.style.setProperty("--ry", (px * 10) + "deg");
      portrait.style.setProperty("--rx", (-py * 10) + "deg");
    });
  }

  /* Card spotlight */
  function glow(e, el) {
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    el.style.setProperty("--x", (e.clientX - r.left) + "px");
    el.style.setProperty("--y", (e.clientY - r.top) + "px");
  }
  window.glow = glow;

  /* Works filter */
  document.querySelectorAll(".filter").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      document.querySelectorAll(".filter").forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn));
      const f = btn.dataset.filter;
      document.querySelectorAll(".work").forEach(w => {
        w.hidden = !(f === "all" || w.dataset.cat === f);
      });
    });
  });

  /* Contact form: validation + Web3Forms submission */
  const WEB3FORMS_ENDPOINT = "https://api.web3forms.com/submit";
  const form = document.getElementById("contactForm");
  const submitBtn = document.getElementById("submitBtn");
  const statusEl = document.getElementById("formStatus");
  const waReveal = document.getElementById("waReveal");

  const fields = {
    name: { wrap: document.getElementById("fName"), test: v => v.trim().length > 1 },
    email: { wrap: document.getElementById("fEmail"), test: v => /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v.trim()) },
    message: { wrap: document.getElementById("fMsg"), test: v => v.trim().length >= 10 }
  };

  function showStatus(type, text) {
    statusEl.className = "form-status show " + type;
    statusEl.textContent = text;
  }

  form.addEventListener("submit", async e => {
    e.preventDefault();

    let valid = true;
    Object.entries(fields).forEach(([id, f]) => {
      const ok = f.test(form[id].value);
      f.wrap.classList.toggle("invalid", !ok);
      if (!ok) valid = false;
    });
    if (!valid) return;

    if (form.access_key.value === "YOUR_WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY") {
      showStatus("err", "Form isn't connected yet. Please add your Web3Forms access key, or reach me directly by email or WhatsApp.");
      return;
    }

    submitBtn.disabled = true;
    submitBtn.textContent = "Sending…";
    statusEl.className = "form-status";

    try {
      const response = await fetch(WEB3FORMS_ENDPOINT, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Accept": "application/json" },
        body: new FormData(form)
      });
      const result = await response.json();

      if (result.success) {
        showStatus("ok", "Thanks! Your message has been sent. I'll get back to you soon.");
        waReveal.classList.add("show");
        form.reset();
      } else {
        showStatus("err", result.message || "Something went wrong. Please try again or contact me on WhatsApp.");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showStatus("err", "Network error. Please check your connection and try again, or contact me on WhatsApp.");
    } finally {
      submitBtn.disabled = false;
      submitBtn.textContent = "Send Message →";
    }
  });
</script>

<script>
/* Reliable cinematic intro / replay. Replay always returns to portfolio hero/header. */
(()=>{
 const overlay=document.getElementById('vpIntro');
 const skip=document.getElementById('vpSkip');
 const replay=document.getElementById('vpReplay');
 const reduce=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
 let finishTimer=0, savedScroll=0, playing=false;
 function finish(){
   clearTimeout(finishTimer);
   playing=false;
   overlay.classList.remove('is-playing');
   overlay.hidden=true;
   overlay.style.setProperty('display','none','important');
   skip.hidden=true;
   replay.hidden=false;
   // Finish at the hero/header, not at the previous scroll position.
   document.documentElement.style.scrollBehavior='auto';
   window.scrollTo(0,0);
   requestAnimationFrame(()=>{window.scrollTo(0,0);document.documentElement.style.scrollBehavior='';});
 }
 function play(){
   clearTimeout(finishTimer);
   savedScroll=0;
   // Replay must start from top even when triggered while scrolling through projects.
   document.documentElement.style.scrollBehavior='auto';
   window.scrollTo(0,0);
   requestAnimationFrame(()=>{window.scrollTo(0,0);document.documentElement.style.scrollBehavior='';});
   if(reduce){finish();return;}
   playing=true;
   overlay.style.removeProperty('display');
   overlay.hidden=false;
   overlay.classList.remove('is-playing');
   // Reset all CSS animations on replay, including split panels.
   void overlay.offsetWidth;
   overlay.classList.add('is-playing');
   skip.hidden=false;
   replay.hidden=true;
   finishTimer=window.setTimeout(finish,3900);
 }
 skip.addEventListener('click',finish);
 replay.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.preventDefault();play()});
 document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&playing)finish()});
 play();
})();
</script>

<script>
/* Smooth, visible cursor interaction on fine-pointer desktops; fixes stalled requestAnimationFrame. */
(()=>{
 const reduced=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
 const fine=window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;
 if(reduced||!fine)return;
 const glow=document.getElementById('vpCursorGlow');
 const ring=document.getElementById('vpCursorRing');
 const intro=document.getElementById('vpIntro');
 let tx=-500,ty=-500,gx=-500,gy=-500,rx=-500,ry=-500,raf=0;
 const tick=()=>{
   raf=0;
   gx+=(tx-gx)*.13;gy+=(ty-gy)*.13;
   rx+=(tx-rx)*.23;ry+=(ty-ry)*.23;
   glow.style.transform=`translate3d(${gx-120}px,${gy-120}px,0)`;
   const ringSize=document.body.classList.contains('vp-hovering')?46:document.body.classList.contains('vp-clicking')?19:30;
   ring.style.transform=`translate3d(${rx-ringSize/2}px,${ry-ringSize/2}px,0)`;
   if(Math.abs(gx-tx)+Math.abs(gy-ty)+Math.abs(rx-tx)+Math.abs(ry-ty)>.2)raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
 };
 window.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
   if(e.pointerType && e.pointerType!=='mouse')return;
   tx=e.clientX;ty=e.clientY;
   document.body.classList.add('vp-cursor-on');
   document.body.classList.toggle('vp-hovering',!!e.target.closest('a,button,.vp-skill-pill,.card,.work,.case,.stat,.why-list li'));
   if(!raf)raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
   if(intro){const nx=(e.clientX/window.innerWidth-.5)*14;const ny=(e.clientY/window.innerHeight-.5)*10;
      intro.style.setProperty('--intro-px',nx.toFixed(2)+'px');intro.style.setProperty('--intro-py',ny.toFixed(2)+'px');}
   const item=e.target.closest('.card,.stat,.case,.work,.why-list li');
   if(item){const r=item.getBoundingClientRect();item.style.setProperty('--vp-x',e.clientX-r.left+'px');item.style.setProperty('--vp-y',e.clientY-r.top+'px');}
 },{passive:true});
 document.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>document.body.classList.add('vp-clicking'));
 document.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>document.body.classList.remove('vp-clicking'));
 document.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>document.body.classList.remove('vp-cursor-on'));
})();
</script>

<script>
(()=>{
const states=[];
const TARGET_X=210,TARGET_Y=123;
for(const svg of document.querySelectorAll('.vp-hang-section .hanging')){
 const group=svg.querySelector('.hanger');
 const paths=[...svg.querySelectorAll('.cable,.cableBack,.cableGlow,.cableHighlight')];
 const s={svg,group,paths,x:210,y:97,vx:0,vy:0,bend:0,bendVelocity:0,drag:false,id:null,
   tx:210,ty:123,prevX:210,prevY:97,lastMove:0,settled:false};
 states.push(s);
 const coordinates=ev=>{
   const pt=svg.createSVGPoint();pt.x=ev.clientX;pt.y=ev.clientY;
   const m=svg.getScreenCTM();return m?pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse()):{x:s.x,y:s.y};
 };
 group.addEventListener('pointerdown',ev=>{
   ev.preventDefault();s.drag=true;s.id=ev.pointerId;s.settled=false;
   const p=coordinates(ev);s.offsetX=s.x-p.x;s.offsetY=s.y-p.y;
   s.prevX=s.x;s.prevY=s.y;s.lastMove=performance.now();s.vx=0;s.vy=0;
   group.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId);group.style.cursor='grabbing';
 });
 group.addEventListener('pointermove',ev=>{
   if(!s.drag||s.id!==ev.pointerId)return;
   const p=coordinates(ev);
   s.tx=Math.max(95,Math.min(325,p.x+s.offsetX));
   s.ty=Math.max(62,Math.min(270,p.y+s.offsetY));
 });
 const finish=ev=>{
